lines: Is Brad around? I'd love a quick word with him.
Any chance you could get him on the line for me right now?
I'd rather just chat with him directly, if he's free.
Put me through to him, please.
Is there a real person I can talk to?
I don't want to leave a message. I want to talk to him.
agent: I can take a message, or connect you to him now.
I would like to leave a message with him.
Just have him call me back. I can't talk right now.
Could he give me a call next week?
No need to bother him. Just pass on my number.
Can you email him my details?
What kind of projects does he take on?
agent: Would you like me to connect you to him?
